name: RecordHeader

issues.title: Premature title truncation
issues.description: The primary incident title truncates aggressively on a single line instead of wrapping.
issues.evidence: Title renders as 'Checkout la...' despite available vertical space below it.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title text to wrap to a second line before applying truncation.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: title span hardcoded whitespace-nowrap + single-line ellipsis. Fixed in RecordHeader.tsx: title now wraps (line-clamp-2 ≥30rem; wrap freely with the record-id chip on its own line below via mobile:line-clamp-none + mobile:flex-wrap/mobile:w-full <30rem). Confirmed at 320px: full title renders on 4 lines, no truncation; desktop unchanged (single line, chip beside title).

notes: Also addressed an unflagged pair-031 observation: the two action Buttons are component-owned (hardcoded size=small, 32px), not page-composed — added a phone-only (<30rem) invisible ::after hit-area expansion (40px tall, ui/sidebar idiom) to both buttons without changing their visual size. Note: pair-103 re-audit (2 runs used) still lists a ui:sidebar 'uncollapsed sidebar on narrow viewport' major — that is page composition in src/app/eval/pair-103/page.tsx (blocked-external for this agent).
